snippet.title: You only have to roll six sixes in a row. | Still Rolling
snippet.description:
A dark office. A monitor glows. A clock hangs on the wall. Through the window, moonlight spills in. A die waits.

The scene never changes. Only the text does.

As you roll, short fragments appear — thoughts, observations, questions. No cutscenes. No characters. Just words that grow slowly the longer you stay. The visuals are the cage. The text is what lives inside it.

Steam: Coming soon
Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/silverstaticstudio/2058082967?ref=8o3zfp
